column5: The Revenue Ranking pivot displays total revenue generated by each menu item, sorted in descending order. This identifies which products contribute most to overall sales performance.
The Monthly Revenue Trend pivot aggregates total revenue (SUM of Total Spent) by month. It provides a time-based view of revenue performance and reveals seasonal movement patterns.
The Location Split pivot aggregates total revenue (SUM of Total Spent) by service channel (In-store, Takeaway, Unknown) and expresses each as a percentage of total revenue.
